name: text-reveal
title: Text Reveal
description: Reveals text with a blur, fade, and slide when it scrolls into view.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay in seconds before the reveal starts.

accessibility: The reveal is decorative; the text is present in the DOM and readable by screen readers regardless of animation state.
touch: No pointer-following. The reveal triggers on scroll into view, which works identically on touch.
reducedMotion: Blur and slide are dropped; the text fades in with a short opacity transition.
